corrections.text: The article states the 66%/34% Ford/Geely ownership split was 'confirmed by CleanTechnica' among other outlets. CleanTechnica's own article actually states 'Ford will own 66 percent of the partnership and Geely will own the remaining 44 percent' — a figure that does not match the 34% reported everywhere else (and is itself an impossible split, since 66% + 44% = 110%). The 66%/34% split itself is correct and independently confirmed by Ford and Geely's joint press release, Geely's own release, WardsAuto, and Automotive Logistics — only the claim that CleanTechnica corroborates the 34% figure is inaccurate.

The article attributes Jim Baumbick's quote — 'What we've achieved in Valencia, with the ongoing support of Spain's national and regional governments, is a masterclass in public-private partnership that sets the benchmark for the rest of Europe' — to both WardsAuto and Automotive Logistics as sources that 'also reported' it. WardsAuto's article does not contain this quote. Only Automotive Logistics reproduces it; the quote itself is genuine and verified verbatim in the Ford/Geely joint press release.
